channel.title: The Morning Brief
channel.description: A five to six minute daily audio digest of Supreme Court and High Court judgments, new laws, national news and editorials, for law students and judiciary aspirants in India.
channel.itunes:author: Eklav

item.title: The Morning Brief, Tuesday 10 November 2026
item.description: The Morning Brief for Tuesday, 10 November 2026. In this edition: Hindu Succession | Grandson Has No Birthright In Property Devolved On Father In Partition Of Grandfather's Estate : Supreme Court; Compulsory Retirement Order Not Punitive Or Stigmatic, So No Hearing Of Employee Needed : Supreme Court; Vishwajeet Singh @ Bishwajeet Ramanand v State of Bihar & Ors; RTI | Information Sought To Examine Recruitment Fairness Can't Be Denied For Failure To First Establish Irregularities: P&H High Court; Telangana High Court Seeks State's Response On Farmer's Plea Against Denial Of ₹2 Lakh Crop Loan Waiver; India, U.S. vow to jointly act against emerging drug threats; and 12 more stories.
